purpose: Off-namespace founder wallet identities; not EVM predeploy or custody addresses
rules: Never store a private key, mnemonic, seed, password, recovery code, or passkey credential in this repository.
A reserved founder wallet is a normal founder-controlled 0x address, never a 0x041f-0x04ff system contract.
Wallet identity is fixed by the signed Genesis authorization record and immutable contract bindings.
An address is not verified merely by being entered in this file; verify a chain-specific signature or successful claim transaction from that address.
An unclaimed or null founder address blocks live authorization deployment; testnet and mainnet claims and credentials are independently qualified.
The three payees' 50/25/25 compensation entitlement is separate from the three 50/25/25 Genesis founder vesting grants; neither is a generic Treasury transfer permission.
A valid EIP-191 founder-signed, network-/chain-/Genesis-bound message is required BEFORE deployment; an on-chain claim transaction is possible only AFTER network Genesis.
Before V4 approval, stage public founder addresses in both address mirrors and the liquid Genesis allocation ledger; never change those authority-input bytes after freeze.

Only independently obtained EIP-191 signatures, or live code-bound EIP-1271 results against an authenticated target-chain genesis, qualify each founder; never substitute a synthetic signer or one founder for another.
Claim receipt evidence requires finalized on-chain state, the exact immutable roles and plan commitment, codehash and one canonical claim event for each actual founder.
